description: Migrate the existing Vite frontend from legacy Go/SQLite endpoints and websocket assumptions to Convex-backed state and subscriptions, using the Bun runtime bridge only where required.
deviation_notes: Added adapter boundary (dataAdapter.ts), imperative Convex hooks (no React provider), and unified log stream hook. Additional Convex query functions needed in backend. Stats/sprints/deps pages remain on Go API — no Convex schema yet.
